title: Technical Rating (per-symbol)
description: Shared shape of the per-symbol `rating` object (metron-ops#293) — the close-only TradingView-Technical-Ratings-method summary computed by features.feature_engineer.compute_technical_rating. Embedded verbatim in both technicals.schema.json (`technicals.*.rating`) and technical_ratings.schema.json (`ratings.*`, which adds price/bar_date/basis on top of this shape). NOT independently loaded — kept as a standalone file for reference/diffing; each consuming schema inlines its own copy so a single json.load() validates the whole artifact without a resolver.

score.description: Mean of the (up to two) group scores present; a zero-vote group is dropped from the average rather than counted as 0.

ma_score.description: Mean of the MA-group votes (SMA+EMA at 10/20/30/50/100/200, up to 12), or null if zero were computable.

osc_score.description: Mean of the oscillator-group votes (RSI14, MACD(12,26,9), Momentum(10), up to 3), or null if zero were computable.

rating_version.description: The RATING_VERSION (features.feature_engineer) that computed this rating -- metron-ops#297. Bumped whenever the vote rules change, so a ledger/scorer consumer can filter to the current rule set.
